camel_example: aliyun iot SubscribeTopic --region cn-hangzhou --Topic.1 'example-string' --IotInstanceId 'iot-06000' --ProductKey a1Q5XoY000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Subscribes to topics for a specified device
description_zh: 该接口为指定设备订阅Topic
kebab_example: aliyun iot subscribe-topic --iot-instance-id iot-06000 --product-key a1Q5XoY000 --device-name device1 --topic example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubscribeTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If <props="intl"><ph>the Overview page or </ph></props>this parameter is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The DeviceName of the device to which the topics you want to subscribe to belong
parameters.help_zh: 指定要订阅Topic所属设备的DeviceName
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The topics to subscribe to. A maximum of 10 topics can be specified.

The operation permission of the topic must be Subscribe or Publish and Subscribe
parameters.help_zh:
要订阅的Topic，最多订阅10个Topic。

Topic的操作权限必须为订阅或发布和订阅
parameters.name: topic
